FastMediaSorter for Web - product icon set (vendored by S0063, 2026-11-16)

What this folder holds: the product's own identity artwork, the face of
"FastMediaSorter for Web" in a browser tab, a bookmark and an iOS/iPadOS
home-screen tile. Derived, not redrawn, from the family's reference icon:

  Source (read-only, never modified):
  FastMediaSorter Android (FMS_A)
  P:\ANDROID\FastMediaSorter_mob_v2\app_v2\src\main\res\mipmap-xxxhdpi\ic_launcher.png
  the standard 192 px legacy launcher: the leaning double-headed arrows of the
  FMS mark, blue gradient (#0B82EB..#98CFF1) on a dark plate, corner rounding
  as shipped.

  favicon.ico          frames 16, 32, 48 px - LANCZOS downscales of the source
  apple-touch-icon.png 180 x 180          - LANCZOS downscale of the source

  Both artifacts are byte-equal to a recompute from that source: proven at
  vendoring (2026-11-16) and re-proven at the wiring pass (2026-11-17,
  ICON-SET-LOCAL: PASS, exit 0). The recompute script is development scratch
  under temp/S0063/ - local, git-ignored, not part of the served tree.
  Rebuild with: py -3 temp/S0063/build_app_icon.py

Corroborated against the second native sibling (sampled 2026-11-16, read-only):
FastMediaSorter_Win P:\WINDOWS\FastMediaSorter_Lite\assets\icons\Fast_Media_Sorter.ico
- the same leaning blue mark, no plate, alpha outside.

Owner request (2026-11-16, S0063): FMS_Web must inherit the icons and symbols
used by FMS_A and FMS_Win, and its main icon must remind of FMS_A. The choice
of the plate form follows that sentence. Interface glyphs are NOT in this
folder: they are the ICON-SET vocabulary vendored under web/vendor/icon-set/;
the exchange server mark is under web/vendor/exchange-mark/.

Wired (2026-11-17, the S0063 acceptance pass): web/index.html points the page
favicon at vendor/app-icon/favicon.ico and the iOS/iPadOS home-screen tile at
vendor/app-icon/apple-touch-icon.png, under EXCHANGE-MARK 0.5 rule 13 - the
owner accepted PROPOSAL-2026-11-16-fms-web-product-favicon.md on 2026-11-16:
the web client page the server serves is the product's own page and keeps the
product's own favicon, and the exchange mark stays beside the server name and
on every surface that names the server.
Nothing in this folder may be recoloured, retinted, further rotated, flipped or
drawn over; a change comes as a new derivation from the source above.
